title: When the Machine Burns
author: Jonah Eriksen
blurb: Xanthe Nakamura, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when the station AI begins confessing to crimes nobody reported, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must reach the relay at the edge of dead space, racing the signal before the jump window closes.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
